errors.evidence: The figure shows the value at dimension 256 is approximately 0.754, but the peak at dimension 512 is approximately 0.755 (visually higher than 0.754). Describing both as 0.754 is inaccurate for the peak value at 512, which appears to be ~0.755.

The y-axis range shown in the figure extends up to approximately 0.756 (the top gridline appears to be above 0.754), and the peak data point at 512 is above 0.754. The y-axis maximum appears to be around 0.756.

The y-axis gridlines are at 0.746, 0.748, 0.750, 0.752, 0.754, which is indeed an interval of 0.002. However, there appears to be another gridline above 0.754 (around 0.756), so the range stated is incomplete.
